text_block_list.name: Noble Lady
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! Somebody please catch my darling 
Maria~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Whoa, the doggy's coming this way!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: All right...! I'll, I'll c-catch you--

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyowa?! Th-The leash is around my 
legsss~~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto was dragged around by the dog 
until sundown, leaving her completely 
exhausted.
